10900.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

east.description: To the east lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

south.description: To the south lies Heading East On Quickstream.

10900.description:
You drift on the dark swell of the Ocean Stream, a broad current that
pours steadily toward the edge of the world. Black water slides past in
long, smooth ridges, and the far horizon bends downward like the lip of
a bowl. Cold spray beads on the gunwale under your hand. The stream
carries you on east, and there is no turning back against it.

10901.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

north.description: To the north lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10901.description:
The stream bends here and the current quickens, hissing along the hull
in pale seams of foam. Gulls wheel high overhead, crying thinly, and the
air tastes of salt and distance. Far across the water a grey haze hangs
where sea and sky should meet. The water runs north around the bend,
while a calmer reach lies back west.

10902.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

south.description: To the south lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10902.description:
A long, oily swell lifts you and sets you down again, slow as breathing.
Drifting weed streams past in tangled green ropes, torn from some
drowned shelf far below. The wind has dropped to a mutter, and the only
sound is the lapping of water against wood. The current runs west from
here, and the quieter water behind you lies south.

10903.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

north.description: To the north lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

east.description: To the east lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10903.description:
Spindrift blows across the stream in sheets, stinging your eyes and
rimming every rope with white crystals of salt. The sea here is a hard
slate colour, pocked by sudden gusts. Something pale, perhaps a bleached
spar, turns slowly in the wash and slips astern. The stream bears on
north, and east lies the way you came.

10904.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

north.description: To the north lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

south.description: To the south lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10904.description:
The water grows strangely clear, and you can see long shafts of light
sinking into green depths where nothing moves. A cold breath rises off
the surface, smelling of stone and old rain. The sky has paled to the
colour of tin, with no sun to be found. The stream runs straight on
north, with the bend lying back south.

10905.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

east.description: To the east lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

south.description: To the south lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10905.description:
Here the current swings hard and the boat heels, shipping a cold slap of
green water over the side. Ahead the swell steepens into rolling hills
of grey, each crest torn by the wind. A low line of cloud lies across
the sky like a lid. The stream turns east toward wider water, and the
long straight reach lies back south.

10906.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

east.description: To the east lies Gulf on Gondor Island.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10906.description:
The stream widens and slows, its hurrying current easing into a sullen,
heaving calm. Broken timbers drift in the wash, grey with age and furred
with weed, the remains of ships that never came home. A faint brine-
heavy fog clings to the surface. East the water opens into a gulf, and
the stream you have followed lies west.

10907.name: Gulf on Gondor Island

north.description: To the north lies Nearing the Rim of the World.

east.description: To the east lies The Ruins of an Ancient City.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10907.description:
You float on the wide, restless water of the gulf, ringed by a pale and
hazy sky. To the east the water laps against broken stones, the tumbled
edge of a city older than any chart. Cold wind pushes at you from the
open sea, bringing a distant rumble from beyond the world's rim. Open
water lies west back to the stream, and a darker stretch of sea leads
north toward the edge.

10908.name: The Ruins of an Ancient City

north.description: To the north lies At the Mound among the Ruins.

west.description: To the west lies Gulf on Gondor Island.

10908.description:
Fallen walls and shattered columns rise out of a tangle of gnarled
trees, where roots have split the old paving and heaved it into ridges.
A salt wind hums through empty window arches, and lichen paints the
stones in rust and yellow. Under the thorn and bramble a faint track
threads the rubble. The ground slopes down west toward the gulf, while
the track runs on north to a great mound among the ruins.

10909.name: At the Mound among the Ruins

north.description: To the north lies The Ruins of an Ancient City.

south.description: To the south lies The Ruins of an Ancient City.

west.description: To the west lies The Ruins of an Ancient City.

up.description: To the up lies The Mound of Concealed Demise.

10909.description:
A grassy barrow-hill swells up here out of the rubble, ringed by broken
pillars that lean away from it like mourners. The wind is quieter in
this hollow, and the grass lies flat and silvered. A narrow stair of
worn stones climbs up the slope toward a dark opening in the top of the
mound. Paths run through the ruins north, south and west.

extra_descs.stair stones steps stair-stones:
The steps are cut from black stone and polished by wind. Faint spirals,
almost erased, climb the risers like the coils of a sleeping serpent.

10910.name: The Mound of Concealed Demise

down.description: To the down lies At the Mound among the Ruins.

10910.description:
The air within the mound is still, cold and heavy with the smell of
earth and old bronze. Rough stone slabs wall a low chamber, and thick
roots hang from the roof like grey hair. A great flat bier stands at the
heart of the room, crusted with the green of corroded grave goods. The
only way out is the passage down the slope, back to the foot of the
mound.

10911.name: The Ruins of an Ancient City

south.description: To the south lies At the Mound among the Ruins.

10911.description:
The ruins end in a broken terrace here, strewn with slabs that were once
the floor of some great hall. A single arch still stands, and wind howls
softly through it. Thorn trees crowd the fallen stones, bending all one
way from long years of gales. The path runs back south to the mound
among the ruins.

10912.name: The Ruins of an Ancient City

east.description: To the east lies At the Mound among the Ruins.

10912.description:
A row of headless statues stands in the brush, their robes worn smooth
and their pedestals buried in leaf mould. Ivy crawls over the toppled
lintel of a gate that opens on nothing at all. The air smells of wet
stone, and somewhere a loose shingle ticks in the breeze. A path winds
back east through the weeds to the mound among the ruins.

10913.name: Nearing the Rim of the World

east.description: To the east lies Nearing the Rim of the World.

south.description: To the south lies Gulf on Gondor Island.

10913.description:
The water here has a strange tilt to it, running faster with each fathom
as though the whole sea were leaning on a slope. Foam streaks the
surface in long white lines, all pointing the same way. The sky ahead is
a hard and cloudless blue, curiously close. The current sweeps on east,
and the gulf lies south behind you.

10914.name: Nearing the Rim of the World

north.description: To the north lies The Rim of the World.

west.description: To the west lies Nearing the Rim of the World.

10914.description:
The roar of the world's edge has grown to a steady thunder that shakes
the boat in your hands. Mist boils up from somewhere ahead, drenching
you in cold droplets and hiding the horizon in white. The stream sets
firmly north toward the brink, but if you must flee the sound, the way
back runs west.

10915.name: The Rim of the World

south.description: To the south lies The Rim of the World.

up.description: To the up lies Nearing the Rim of the World.

10915.description:
You are at the Rim of the World itself, where the sea slides over the
lip of the sky and falls into endless white mist. A pale rainbow arches
silently over the abyss and is gone, then glimmers again. Nothing lies
beyond but air, cloud and a long, soft thunder. The only way from here
is south, back along the failing stream.

645500.name: shark grey rim
645500.long_desc: A lean grey shark circles in the water, its fin cutting the swell.
645500.description:
A long, scarred shark with eyes like wet slate. It rides the current at
the edge of the world, hungry and unafraid of anything that floats.

645501.name: hound wolf gaunt ruin
645501.long_desc: A gaunt ruin hound prowls between the fallen walls, nose low to the stones.
645501.description:
A starved grey wolf-hound, ribs showing under a coat matted with salt
and burrs. It haunts the ruins, snapping at the wind and anything that
walks there.

645502.name: sailor drowned skeleton
645502.long_desc: A drowned sailor clambers over the rail, streaming water and weed.
645502.description:
Bone and rotted cloth hang together around a sailor's frame, trailing
weed and brine. Empty eye sockets turn toward you, and a rusted knife
glints in its grip.

645503.name: guard barrow skeleton warrior
645503.long_desc: A barrow guard stands among the broken pillars, a green-crusted shield on its arm.
645503.description:
An armoured skeleton in the bronze harness of a lost kingdom, still
standing sentinel over the mound it was buried to guard. Cold blue light
flickers behind its helm.

645504.name: wraith rim spirit
645504.long_desc: A wailing rim wraith hangs in the mist, a pale shape trailing sea-spray.
645504.description:
A tall, grey spirit with a face of drawn and sorrowful mist, wrapped in
cloud and spray. It haunts the brink of the world, drawn to those who
come near the edge.

645505.name: captain harrowmere drowned skeleton
645505.long_desc: Captain Harrowmere the Drowned stands guard at the foot of the mound, a tattered cloak snapping about him.
645505.description:
The bones of a sea captain who sailed to the world's end and never
returned. A cloak of sea-green sailcloth hangs from his shoulders, and a
salt-white cutlass never leaves his hand.

645506.name: barrow king aldric crowned skeleton
645506.long_desc: Aldric, the Barrow-King, sits upright on his bier, a cold crown on his skull.
645506.description:
The king of the ancient city, dead since before the sea turned back from
his walls, yet unwilling to lie down. He rises in rotting mail with a
long black blade across his knees, and the cold of the grave rolls from
him.

745500.name: shark tooth charm
745500.room_desc: A shark-tooth charm lies here, strung on a cord.
745500.description: A hand-long tooth, yellow and serrated, drilled and strung on a salt-stiff cord. Sailors swear it keeps the sea from claiming them.

745501.name: bronze shield barrow
745501.room_desc: A green bronze shield lies in the dust here.
745501.description: A round shield of old bronze, crusted with verdigris. A faded sun-and-wave device still shows on its boss.

745502.name: cloak sailcloth sea-green
745502.room_desc: A sea-green sailcloth cloak lies here, still damp.
745502.description: A heavy cloak of tarred sailcloth, stiff with salt and never quite dry. It turns wind and spray alike.

745503.name: black blade barrow-king sword
745503.room_desc: A long black blade lies here, cold to look upon.
745503.description: A broad blade of dark, pitted iron, longer than a man's arm. Frost beads along its edge even in summer.

745504.name: crown barrow-king iron circlet
745504.room_desc: A tarnished iron crown lies here.
745504.description: A heavy circlet of blackened iron set with dull blue stones, cold as a winter well.
